title: Story premise EDU028: The Disappearing Checkerboard
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (computing/data). Hook: Why do the stripes vanish when the camera steps back? Takeaway/theme: Sampling can lose detail or create misleading patterns when resolution is insufficient.
description: A camera robot wants to capture fine stripes, but its sparse sample points miss alternating details. Sliding the sampling grid changes the recorded pattern and exposes the ambiguity.
